samira: Postmortem follow-up / pager noise spike on 2025-03-21. Need owners for: dedupe rules, threshold tuning, and paging policy decisions. Keep updates here.
oke: I'll own dedupe experiments. Proposal: 30s sliding window keyed by (service, error_code). Quick test in staging, ETA 5 business days.
leigh: I'll take thresholds and run the baseline job across 60d to get p90/p95/p99 per service. Will propose conservative threshold increases for noisy signals. ETA 4 days.
sre-bot: Incident 2025-03-21: page-spike-retries  378 pages in 4h. Runbook: https://redwood.incidents/2025-03-21-spike (auto-attached).
samira: For paging policy, I recommend soft-page (channel) for non-SLA and hard-page for Sev0/1 with auto-escalate after 12m. Who can draft the matrix?
pat: I can draft the paging matrix doc and include canary plan (5% services) + rollback steps. ETA 7 days.
oke: local dedupe config I'm testing:
```yaml
alert: downstream-retries
for: 3m
dedupe_key: "{{service}}:{{error_code}}"
dedupe_window: 30s
```
leigh: metric query I'm running to find noisy alerts:
```
sum by(alertname) (rate(alert_events_total[5m]))
```
samira: Add all links and PRs to action tracker: https://docs.redwood/pmt/alert-remediations. We'll convert to JIRA and set risk tags.
sre-bot: Reminder: oncall sync 2025-03-24 09:00 PST. Agenda item added: alert-tuning checkin.
oke: Putting PR for dedupe into staging tomorrow morning, will ping here when ready.
leigh: I'll attach baseline graphs to the tracker after the job completes tonight.
pat: Drafting paging matrix now and will share a short summary for review.
samira: Thanks all  let's keep this thread as the single place for status updates and close items during the sync. :thumbsup:
